title: Portfolio Deep Dives
subtitle: One company at a time across a mid-market private equity portfolio
description: Nora and James spend each episode on a single portfolio company: what it does, the industry it sits in, the problem it solves for customers, the pressures it faces and where AI and new technology could change the business. Thirty companies across seven seasons. Built from public sources only; not investment or legal advice.
author: Nora & James

seasons.title: Legal and professional services
seasons.description: Law firm software, expert witnesses, litigation economics and dispute resolution.

seasons.title: Data, analytics and financial administration
seasons.description: Credit data, regulatory software, supply chain research, farm data and ESOP administration.

seasons.title: Healthcare services
seasons.description: Medical communications, diagnostics, veterinary care and home care.

seasons.title: Testing, inspection and compliance
seasons.description: Environmental permitting, cleanroom certification, safety inspection, water operations and lab testing.

seasons.title: Industrial field services and products
seasons.description: On-site machining and repair, test plugs, compressed air tools and food service fixtures.

seasons.title: Education and training
seasons.description: Corporate skills practice, tutoring and veterinary education.

seasons.title: Consumer and multi-unit
seasons.description: Golf club fitting, doughnuts, aesthetics clinics and confectionery franchises.
